records.purpose: Trip and medical-travel coordination owns itinerary, destination/accessibility and provider comparison views. This resolves 778: country/city/cost/reviews are travel-planning context, while actual provider identity stays CAP-IDENTITY and success-rate definitions stay CAP-RESEARCH. Preserve clinic/dentist selection, accessible airports/hotels/pharmacies/hospitals, equipment rental, medicine/visa/insurance and advisory references. Success rates require source/cohort/denominator/time and missingness before comparison; no ranking, treatment eligibility or outcome guarantee is inferred. Shared-profile/contact/QR flags record intent, not grants. Current country rules require authoritative version/date evidence; historical source examples are not current advice.
records.scope: Append-only travel-coordination profile; no replacement of earlier owner profiles
records.workflow: Resolve authorized patient/trip/source context → preserve source/version and applicable jurisdiction/time → qualified review of comparison or clinical implications → disclose bounded view → record correction, delivery and provenance.
records.clinical_safety: No credential, directory membership, risk score or clinical model can grant treatment authority or unrestricted patient access. Fail closed for the non-emergency MVP read; do not claim emergency response, clinical clearance or certification.
records.privacy: Purpose-limited minimum disclosure with separate tenant/patient/recipient checks, guardian/adolescent restrictions and protected credential/audit metadata. No raw bearer tokens, biometric samples or unrestricted health payloads in logs.
records.failure_modes: Unknown, expired, revoked, contradictory or unavailable identity/role/grant/source yields denial or explicit unavailable state. Preserve source history and idempotent correction; never silently expand permissions on retry.
records.acceptance: Trace every nonempty source fragment to a canonical anchor; verify credential and facility differences survive normalization. Future runtime acceptance must cover wrong patient/tenant/purpose, revoked/expired role, dependency failure, stale source and concurrent revoke/read. Structural tests do not establish runtime protection.
records.open_gates: Typed schemas, current policy/provider configuration, runtime and qualified acceptance evidence are incomplete.
